n: CATEDU Pensamiento computacional y actividades desenchufadas
t: A free Spanish online book on computational thinking and unplugged activities.
steps: Find the CATEDU book on computational thinking and unplugged activities.
Read the chapter on the four pillars.
Open the chapter on unplugged activities.
Export the book to PDF for printing.
Print the cards and boards for one activity.
Try the activity with a small group.
